The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: rf leads in trend tracking (perfect correlation), catboost excels in seasonality (highest positive seasonal corr). ONLY_FT_rf is the overall RMSE champion. Early specialists like ONLY_FT_catboost and late specialists like FT_rf show horizon-specific strengths. High model disagreement and unpredictable ytrue (spectral entropy 0.93) justify robust combiners like median/trimmed mean.
